integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 3D CG animation with a fantasy-nature style blending natural realism and fantasy, rendered in refined textures and a low-saturation deep cold palette of mist blue and ink green. A single unbroken long take opens at daybreak (破晓时刻) on a medium, eye-level framing with shallow depth of field, focus locked on the subject, centered composition. In an open forest clearing, a vast distant sky glows with the pale cyan chill of first light, while a thick branch extends from the right of frame toward the left at mid-ground, its tip carrying a few scattered pale-green leaves trembling gently in the morning breeze. Diffuse dawn light is the sole illumination, falling as a soft side-backlight with no hard shadows. The sole subject — a raven formed of condensing light dust (由光尘凝聚而成的渡鸦) — hovers in the upper-left pale-blue sky region, body slightly angled toward camera, wings fully spread, its feather edges made of fine dense particles shimmering faintly in the soft daylight, its two eyes emitting a cold cyan-green glow (双眼透出幽冷的青绿色微光). After a brief hover pause, the raven glides along one smooth, continuous arc toward the lower right of frame, wings beating in a calm rhythm; each wingbeat throws off showers of sparkling particles (每一次振翅都扬起大量闪耀微粒) that trail fleeting streaks of light through the air. Throughout the descent the camera pushes in slowly and at constant speed, tightening from medium shot to medium-close. As the raven arrives above the branch at the center-lower frame, it folds its wings neatly and lands with precision, claws gripping firmly into the rough bark (爪部稳稳扣住粗糙树皮), body dipping slightly with residual momentum before settling back into balance. Perched, it slowly turns its head, the cyan-green glowing eyes cautiously sweeping the surroundings, and releases one low, hoarse, drawn-out raven call — "啊—" — strikingly clear in the silent morning forest.

overall_soundscape: Faint morning birdsong and rustling leaves interweave across the quiet clearing. Rhythmic wingbeats produce a soft whoosh with a subtle particle shimmer as sparkling motes scatter through the air. Claws close on the rough bark with a textured grip, followed by the raven's low, hoarse, prolonged "啊—" call ringing distinctly through the still morning.
